SQL 115's file and its intended fingerprint 8aed39a4 are unchanged. No predecessor: SQL 119 does not need SQL 115, is a no-op once the owner is the only grantee (staging after SQL 115: the tools refuse it as already in place). The function's callers (trg_sync_provider_stakeholder_account(), autoadd_partner_stakeholder_on_share(), add_partner_stakeholder_to_check(uuid, uuid)) are SECURITY DEFINER and run as the owner, and the API never calls it, so no caller loses access. Nothing in the repository grants the function to checksops again, so it is not re-run after SQL 115.
